neighbours.label: The conjunction or comma in a step-by-step instruction that sets up repeating the same step on the next item ('move to the next row and [repeat]'), vs instructions where the 'and' leads to a different, finishing action
fire: Sand the first board until smooth. Move to the next board and sand it the same way.
Plant one seed in each hole, then go to the next row and do the same.
Tie a knot at the first mark, slide down to the next mark and tie another.
Paint the top panel, wait ten minutes, then move on to the next panel and paint it too.
Check the first tire's pressure, walk to the next tire and check it as well.
Scrape the old paint off one shutter, then take down the next shutter and scrape it.
Fill the first jar to the brim, set it aside, pick up the next jar and fill it.
Stitch along the first seam, turn the fabric to the next seam and stitch again.
quiet: Sand the first board until smooth. Wipe off the dust and apply a coat of oil.
Plant one seed in each hole, then cover the bed with soil and water it well.
Tie a knot at the end of the rope, pull it tight and trim the loose end.
Paint the top panel, wait ten minutes, then remove the tape and clean the brush.
Check the tire's pressure, close the valve cap and drive home slowly.
Scrape the old paint off the shutter, then rinse the scraper and put it away.
Fill the jar to the brim, screw on the lid and store it in the fridge.
Stitch along the seam, cut the thread and press the fabric flat.

predictions: 'next item and' setups reach 0.5-1.2 on ' and'; finishing-step instructions stay around 0.3 or lower.
notes: Output of this pole promotes 'repeat'. Probe: 'move to the next window and do the same' 1.186, 'Move to the next strip and repeat' 0.908, 'rest for a minute, then do another set' 0.607, 'rinse and repeat' 0.540; 'Glue the first strip to the frame and let the whole frame dry' 0.333 (leak level for non-repeat instructions); narrative 'and' 0.011.
